# Print Book vs. E-Book Sales Statistics

 March 27, 2026 November 15, 2022 by Danny McLoughlin 

- Roughly 4 print books sell for every e-book that sells
- Print books are the most popular reading format amongst both children and adults
- 65% of American adults have read a print book within the past year
- 37% of Americans claim that they only read print books
- This compares to 7% of Americans claim that they only read e-books
- 28% say they read both print books and e-books

| 2020 | 191 | 751 |

## Amazon print book vs e-book sales statistics

- Amazon is known to have sold more than 487 million e-books
- Amazon sells approximately 300 million print books each year
- Amazon’s share of the US print book market is at least 40%
- Amazon’s share of the US e-book market is thought to be around 67%
- There are thought to be at least 5 million e-books available on Amazon
- There are thought to be at least 20 million different print titles available on Amazon
